title: South Cotabato tilapia festival seeks bigger markets for fish farmers

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — South Cotabato is looking to expand markets for its tilapia industry as it launched its first five-day Tilapia Festival on Monday, Oct. 26, to help fish farmers reach more buyers and boost their livelihoods. Running until Oct. 30, the festival features a product expo, aquaculture training, lake cleanups, bamboo planting, cooking contests, art workshops and cultural performances. It will culminate in Sugba-Sugba sa Dalan, a street-grilling event showcasing locally produced tilapia.
